channel.title: Lachesis on BLINK
channel.description: Recent content in Lachesis on BLINK

item.title: Aris
item.description:
Eri’s mentor and surrogate father. Knows the ancient texts and the properties of obsidian and the void. He makes the void vials and the dissolution tonic.

Beyond

He dies in the castle siege, spending his last void vial to seal Lachesis safe. The mob kills him. Eri feels his life-thread snap, and the grief triggers her breakthrough blink.

item.title: Eri
item.description:
Fourteen at the story’s start. A defiant punk – outwardly confident, practical, observant, dry. Secretly the princess of Kraeta.

She refuses to stay blind.

Beyond

Daughter of King Lachesis and Queen Hren. Her father set an anchor on her forehead at age four; it is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: Queen Hren
item.description:
Queen of Kraeta. Eri’s mother. Rhodes says she leapt from a cliff.

Beyond

Rhodes lies. She gave herself to his cause, and when her usefulness ran out he discarded her to the homunculi. Her arc mirrors Eri’s: both offered paradise, both forced to choose.

item.title: The Anchor
item.description:
A mark set on Eri’s forehead by her father when she was four.

Beyond

It is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: The Golden Path
item.description: Lachesis’s foresight – the tapestry of time. He sees the threads.

item.title: The Green-Thumbs
item.description: A conspiratorial faction. Their agents stoke the mob against the King and plot long-term economic infiltration. Endurance always wins.

item.title: Void Vials
item.description:
Aris’s work. Obsidian and the void, bottled.

Beyond

One of them seals Lachesis safe. It costs Aris his life.
